title: Taganrog Theatre
scope: Standing Taganrog Chekhov Drama Theatre at 90 Petrovskaya Street, its cream two-storey historic entrance, lower flanking bays, auditorium envelope and red-brick rear stage blocks.
limitations: The named outline controls the perimeter. The model follows the 2007 front elevation and standing theater’s documented continuity. Rear stages and side windows, roof pitch, exact heights, small railing metalwork and minor door differences are approximate.
The stage machinery, auditorium interiors, neighboring buildings, streets and overhead wires are outside the modeled exterior.
